newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS surges as bad 1996 results digested.
newsitem.headline: AMS surges as bad 1996 results digested.

text.p: Microchip maker Austria Mikro Systeme was the top gainer in a largely unchanged Vienna market on Wednesday with players shrugging off the miserable batch of 1996 results as being within expectations.
At 0946 GMT, AMS was up 3.82 percent, or 41 schillings, at 1,115 on turnover of 36,500 lots.
Earlier today, AMS reported a group pre-tax loss of 100.6 million schillings in 1996, down from a profit of 266.9 million in 1995, adding it would cut its dividend to 10 schillings from 12.
"The losses had already been largely discounted," said one trader. "These 1996 results had been expected. The only unknown element was the slashed dividend."
AMS also announced it had reduced its stake in its loss-making subsidiary SAMES to 19 percent from 51 percent, effective from September 30, 1996. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12253
